title: Homogeneous multiplication for exact graded data
statement: For every TensorGradedPresentationCore j L, multiplication of the images of homogeneous sections in degrees a and d equals the image in degree a+d under the inverse tensor-power addition isomorphism.

proof.text: On each frame open multiplication is multiplication of polynomial coefficients; transition functions preserve the formula, so the local identities glue and sheaf separation gives the global section identity.

mathlib_searches.query: graded tensor presentation square zero ideal

lean.statement: theorem tensorGradedPresentation_core_multiply {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (T : TensorGradedPresentationCore j L) : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U)) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow d, U)), tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b a).app U s) * tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b d).app U t) = tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b (a + d)).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U (tmulSection s t)))
